articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.snippet: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Crypto is going through a massive dot-com style shakeout as over 100 projects fold in 2026
articles.snippet: An industry-wide reckoning is weeding out unsustainable startups, leaving behind only the protocols with real cash flow and actual users.
